This is fraud (诈骗). Also dealing in prohibited cultural relics: illegal purchase, sale, trafficking of cultural relics. The crime could be "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trade of cultural relics) or "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trafficking of cultural relics). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trade of cultural relics) under Article 277? Actually Article 277 of Criminal Law: "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal buying and selling of cultural relics). Also "诈骗罪" (fraud). So answer likely includes both: 诈骗;非法买卖文物. Also "非法买卖文物" (illegal trade of cultural relics). So final answer: [罪名]诈骗;非法买卖文物<eoa>.
